items.name: Vancouver Fall Fest 2023

venue.name: [St. George's Senior School](https://www.stgeorges.bc.ca/)
venue.details: Dixon Gym on the First Floor

items.information:
Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**.

You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case

Spectators can attend for free. Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a maximum of 2 guests each.

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.

$500 of proceeds from Vancouver Fall Fest 2023 will go to [Kids Help Phone](https://kidshelpphone.ca/), a charity which provides 24/7 support and counseling services to young individuals across Canada who are seeking help, guidance, and a safe space to talk about their concerns and challenges.

**Notice of filming and photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Masks will be optional. Do not attend this event if sick or feeling unwell.

Estamos muy emocionados de anunciar esta competencia tan explosiva, Volcano in Puebla 2023.
Te invitamos a participar y competir en nuestra hermosa ciudad de Puebla, hogar de cemitas y de Don Goyo.
Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del **Instituto Municipal del Deporte** y el **Puebla Rubik's Team**.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la WCA. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcE5KIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1aa6d40f717b497f565be1b12569bbfda1402653/Logo%20Volcano%20final.png)

We are so happy to announce this competition, Volcano in Puebla 2023.
We invite you to participate and to compete in our beautiful city of Puebla, place of cemitas and Don Goyo.
This competition is possible thanks to the support of the **Instituto Municipal del Deporte** and **Puebla Rubik's Team**.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)

venue.name: [El Trompo Museo Interactivo Tijuana](http://www.eltrompo.org)

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdllxIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b16c4555cf884b977f59734b9b046b263e1339d8/image.png)

**Speed Cube Baja Open 2023 es la séptima competencia oficial realizada en la ciudad de Tijuana en el estado de Baja California**
La edición de este año está especializada en weas por lo que Skewb es la categoria principal de esta competencia.
> Este evento es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia.


**Baja Open is the seventh official competition held in Tijuana, Baja California**
In this year's edition, the competition specialized in side events, so Skewb is the main event.
> This event is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand [the WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) prior to the competition.

items.name: Denver Art Museum Mix-Up 2023
items.information:
# **PLEASE READ THE MUSEUM ADMISSION TAB**

We're excited to welcome competitors back to Denver for another fun day of speedcubing!


Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

* **This competition has a 105 competitor limit.** 
* Please Only Bring Two Guests 
* Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition,[ this video ](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM.
* **If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team**, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of October 7, 6:00 PM MDT. 

This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbVUvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6b1dbbfb8fde69539bfd38dc36f5ade063103470/image.png)
